snippet.title: PopStar Guitar game trailer
snippet.description: Jam to the hottest hits with PopStar Guitar!  Over 50 Pop Hits including Masters performed by the original Artists, including All-American Rejects, Miley Cyrus and Blink-182.  Available November 2008 for the Wii and PS2.
